legend: You are given two positive integers $A$ and $B$. Print the floor, the ceiling and the rounded value of $A / B$.\begin{itemize}\item The floor of $X$ is the greatest integer not greater than $X$.\item The ceiling of $X$ is the smallest integer not less than $X$.\item Rounding gives the closest integer to $X$; a value exactly halfway (like 2.5) rounds up.\end{itemize}
input: One line with two integers $A$ and $B$ ($1 \le A, B \le 10^3$).
output: Print three lines, in this order: "floor $A$ / $B$ = $F$", "ceil $A$ / $B$ = $C$" and "round $A$ / $B$ = $R$", where $F$, $C$ and $R$ are the floor, ceiling and rounded value of $A / B$.
